title: Two more strange little worlds join the project list
summary:
Two community-made AI games joined the project list: one Roblox, one involving a suspiciously determined maid.

The community project list now includes Aiko AI: With You Til The End, a Roblox experience, and Convince the Weird Maid to Let You Leave the House. The catalog continues its noble mission of documenting what happens when people have AI infrastructure and questionable narrative premises.
